title_as_printed: CO2 solubility (mol kg-1 w) at 65 C in pure H2O calculated from the calibration line in Fig. 3 as a function of pressure (bar), and difference with the EOS of Duan and Sun (2003) (Delta model, %). The values are the mean of 5-10 measurements at a given pressure.
pressure_note: total pressure of autoclave (IMAGES device, CO2 pressure ; +-0.2 bar); pressure-transducer; exact basis (total vs CO2 partial) not stated

value.note: Raman peak-intensity ratio converted with a calibration line fitted to Duan and Sun (2003) model values at 100 C (not an independent measurement of molality)

extra_unmapped: Delta model (%) (difference to Duan and Sun EOS, calculated by authors)
notes: Printed '%' signs retained in Delta model column; printed minus signs written as '-'.
quality_reason: mole fraction derived through a Raman calibration anchored to an equation of state (audit 2026-10-02)
